verdict.rationale: Spend and quota controls are a fair question for an error-tracking SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents per-project event quotas, rate caps, or spend limits. The volume-based alarms and anomaly detection only send alerts and do not cap ingestion or billing, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can cap event quotas per project and set spend limits so an error storm burns a predictable budget, never a surprise invoice
